sentences.text: Angelina Jolie Pitt -LRB- -LSB- dʒoʊˈliː -RSB- ; née Voight ; born June 4 , 1975 -RRB- is an American actress , filmmaker , philanthropist and humanitarian .

She has received an Academy Award , two Screen Actors Guild Awards , and three Golden Globe Awards , and has been cited as Hollywood 's highest-paid actress .	Academy Award	Academy Award	Screen Actors Guild Awards	Screen Actors Guild Awards	Golden Globe Awards	Golden Globe Awards
Jolie made her screen debut as a child alongside her father , Jon Voight , in Lookin ' to Get Out -LRB- 1982 -RRB- .	Jon Voight	Jon Voight

Her film career began in earnest a decade later with the low-budget production Cyborg 2 -LRB- 1993 -RRB- , followed by her first leading role in a major film , Hackers -LRB- 1995 -RRB- .	Cyborg 2	Cyborg 2	Hackers	Hackers (film)

She starred in the critically acclaimed biographical cable films George Wallace -LRB- 1997 -RRB- and Gia -LRB- 1998 -RRB- , and won an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress for her performance in the drama Girl , Interrupted -LRB- 1999 -RRB- .	Academy Award	Academy Award	George Wallace	George Wallace (film)	Gia	Gia	Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress	Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress
Jolie 's starring role as the video game heroine Lara Croft in Lara Croft : Tomb Raider -LRB- 2001 -RRB- established her as a leading Hollywood actress .	Lara Croft	Lara Croft

She continued her successful action-star career with Mr. & Mrs. Smith -LRB- 2005 -RRB- , Wanted -LRB- 2008 -RRB- , and Salt -LRB- 2010 -RRB- , and received critical acclaim for her performances in the dramas A Mighty Heart -LRB- 2007 -RRB- and Changeling -LRB- 2008 -RRB- , which earned her a nomination for an Academy Award for Best Actress .	Academy Award	Academy Award	Mr. & Mrs. Smith	Mr. & Mrs. Smith (2005 film)	Wanted	Wanted (2008 film)	Salt	Salt (2010 film)	A Mighty Heart	A Mighty Heart (film)	Changeling	Changeling (film)	Academy Award for Best Actress	Academy Award for Best Actress

Beginning in the 2010s , she expanded her career into directing , screenwriting , and producing , starting with the wartime dramas In the Land of Blood and Honey -LRB- 2011 -RRB- and Unbroken -LRB- 2014 -RRB- .	In the Land of Blood and Honey	In the Land of Blood and Honey	Unbroken	Unbroken (film)
Her biggest commercial success came with the fantasy picture Maleficent -LRB- 2014 -RRB- .	Maleficent	Maleficent (film)

In addition to her film career , Jolie is noted for her humanitarian efforts , for which she has received a Jean Hersholt Humanitarian Award and an honorary damehood of the Order of St Michael and St George -LRB- DCMG -RRB- , among other honors .	Jean Hersholt Humanitarian Award	Jean Hersholt Humanitarian Award	Order of St Michael and St George	Order of St Michael and St George

She promotes various causes , including conservation , education , and women 's rights , and is most noted for her advocacy on behalf of refugees as a Special Envoy for the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees -LRB- UNHCR -RRB- .	Special Envoy	Special Envoy	United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees	UNHCR

As a public figure , Jolie has been cited as one of the most influential and powerful people in the American entertainment industry , as well as the world 's most beautiful woman , by various media outlets .
Her personal life is the subject of wide publicity .

Divorced from actors Jonny Lee Miller and Billy Bob Thornton , she separated from her third husband , actor Brad Pitt , in September 2016 .	Jonny Lee Miller	Jonny Lee Miller	Billy Bob Thornton	Billy Bob Thornton	Brad Pitt	Brad Pitt
They have six children together , three of whom were adopted internationally .
